metadata.description: Version-aware healthcare interoperability plugins (DICOM, HL7 v2, FHIR, C-CDA, IHE, X12, NCPDP, IEEE 11073)

plugins.name: healthcare-clinical-interop
plugins.description: Clinical interoperability for HIS/EMR/EHR/LIS/HIE: HL7 v2 (2.1–2.9.1), FHIR (DSTU2–R6) with per-IG versions, CDA/C-CDA and IHE ITI document sharing and patient identity.

plugins.name: healthcare-core
plugins.description: Foundation for all healthcare work: version resolution, interoperability architecture, security/privacy review, terminology and conformance testing.

plugins.name: healthcare-devices
plugins.description: Medical device interoperability: ISO/IEEE 11073 PHD/SDC, IHE PCD and device-to-EHR integration via HL7 v2 or FHIR.

plugins.name: healthcare-imaging
plugins.description: Medical imaging toolkit for PACS, RIS, VNA, modalities, gateways and viewers: DICOM, DICOMweb, PS3.15 security and IHE Radiology, targeted at your declared DICOM edition.

plugins.name: healthcare-revenue-cycle
plugins.description: Healthcare administration and insurance: ASC X12 claims/eligibility/remittance/prior auth (HIPAA 005010 by default) and NCPDP SCRIPT/Telecom/RTPB aligned to regulatory dates.
